metadata.description: Individually selectable HTML skills sharing one offline HTML artifact foundation.

plugins.name: annotated-code-review
plugins.description: Render an evidence-backed code review as an HTML diff with line-anchored findings and severity labels. Use when the user specifically wants an annotated HTML PR review or interactive diff review artifact.

plugins.name: code-path-explainer
plugins.description: Trace a concrete behavior through source code and produce an annotated HTML execution-path explainer. Use when the user wants to understand how a specific code path works, with real snippets and source-linked flow diagrams.

plugins.name: feature-brief
plugins.description: Create a concise HTML overview of a feature's purpose, behavior, architecture, and limitations. Use when the user wants a source-backed feature summary for onboarding, handoff, or stakeholder understanding.

plugins.name: handoff-guide
plugins.description: Write a self-contained HTML handoff or repository overview guide explaining what a project does, why it is built that way, and how to operate and diagnose it. Use when handing a project to another team, onboarding owners, or requesting a project overview, internals guide, ownership document, or handoff doc.

plugins.name: html-artifact
plugins.description: Create self-contained, accessible HTML artifacts for plans, code reviews, explainers, reports, prototypes, and purpose-built editing interfaces. Use when the user requests an HTML artifact or when a specialized skill explicitly delegates its presentation and export layer to this foundation.

plugins.name: implementation-explorer
plugins.description: Create an HTML comparison of implementation approaches grounded in the actual codebase. Use when the user wants alternative technical approaches, tradeoffs, or an HTML decision aid before choosing an implementation.

plugins.name: pr-walkthrough
plugins.description: Create a source-linked HTML companion explaining a pull request to reviewers. Use when the user wants an HTML PR overview, reviewer guide, or visual walkthrough of a change, rather than a defect review.

plugins.name: research-synthesizer
plugins.description: Synthesize authorized documents, code, history, and web or connected-service evidence into a source-linked HTML research report. Use when the user wants a readable HTML synthesis across multiple sources.

plugins.name: technical-diagrammer
plugins.description: Produce accessible SVG technical diagrams embedded in a self-contained HTML artifact. Use when the user wants architecture, sequence, workflow, or state diagrams grounded in supplied evidence.

plugins.name: technical-explainer
plugins.description: Create an HTML learning artifact that teaches a technical concept through diagrams, worked examples, and gotchas. Use when the user wants an interactive explanation or HTML lesson, rather than a source-code trace alone.

plugins.name: visual-implementation-plan
plugins.description: Turn an agreed technical approach into an evidence-linked HTML implementation plan with interfaces, data flow, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. Use when the user requests a visual plan or an HTML handoff for implementation.

plugins.name: weekly-status-report
plugins.description: Create an evidence-linked HTML status report for an explicit reporting period. Use when the user wants a weekly HTML update synthesized from authorized issues, PRs, commits, documents, or supplied notes.
